MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 24
   C. 10
   D. 25

2. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 6
   D. 5

3. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 81

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 27
   C. 17
   D. 31

6. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

7. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

8. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

10. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

11. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 15

12. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 3
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
